THE SPLIT PLATE / RECIPE

Three-Ingredient German Beef + Mash

Three supermarket ingredients, plus water. That counts as a busy parent’s home-cooked family dinner to me.

YIELD4 servings
TOTAL TIME15 min
COOK METHODSee method
EST. / SERVING~360 cal | ~42g protein
KEY TO SUCCESS: Heat the prepared À La Carte Beef Sauerbraten and its gravy according to the package instructions.

Ingredients

Shared

  • À La Carte Beef Sauerbraten with gravy (Burnett Fine Foods, Costco)
  • 88g Idahoan Original dry potato flakes (4 labeled servings / 1 1/3 cups)
  • 1 cup (240ml) Nurri whole ultra-filtered protein milk + 1 1/2 cups boiling water

Adult Plate — 210g Beef Sauerbraten (1.5 Servings) + 1/4 Mash Batch (~363 cal / 41.5g protein)

  • 210g À La Carte Beef Sauerbraten with gravy (1 1/2 labeled servings)
  • Optional: pinch of red chili flakes

Kid Plate — 105g Beef Sauerbraten (3/4 Serving) + Mash + Toasted Rolls

  • 105g À La Carte Beef Sauerbraten with gravy (3/4 labeled serving)
  • Toasted buttered rolls (separate from the 3-ingredient build)

You need a fast, comforting weeknight family dinner using three supermarket staples—Costco À La Carte Beef Sauerbraten, Idahoan potato flakes, and Nurri whole protein milk—landing at ≈363 calories and 41.5g protein per adult plate with zero added butter or oil.

Method

Shared base

  1. 1.Heat the packaged beef sauerbraten and gravy according to its package directions.
  2. 2.Bring 1 1/2 cups water to a boil in a saucepan, remove from heat, and stir in the 88g potato flakes and 1 cup Nurri whole milk until fluffy and creamy. Let stand briefly, then fluff and divide into 4 adult side portions.

Adult Plate — 210g Beef Sauerbraten (1.5 Servings) + 1/4 Mash Batch (~363 cal / 41.5g protein)

  1. 3.Plate 1/4 of the protein-milk mashed potato batch (equivalent to 22g dry flakes + 1/4 cup Nurri whole milk).
  2. 4.Add 210g heated beef sauerbraten and spoon the included gravy over the beef and mash (≈363 cal, 41.5g protein, 24.3g carbs, 11g fat; rounded to ≈360 cal / 42g protein in video).

Kid Plate — 105g Beef Sauerbraten (3/4 Serving) + Mash + Toasted Rolls · Kid Plate — 105g Beef Sauerbraten (3/4 Serving) + Mash + Toasted Rolls

  1. 3.Serve 105g heated beef sauerbraten with gravy, an age-appropriate scoop of the creamy mashed potatoes, and toasted buttered rolls on the side.

SPLIT PLATE SERVING

Adult Plate — 210g Beef Sauerbraten (1.5 Servings) + 1/4 Mash Batch (~363 cal / 41.5g protein): Serve the adult portion as described above.

Kid Plate — 105g Beef Sauerbraten (3/4 Serving) + Mash + Toasted Rolls: Serve the kid portion as described above.

Keys to success

  • Bring 1 1/2 cups water to a boil in a saucepan, remove from the heat, and stir in 88g dry Idahoan potato flakes and 1 cup Nurri whole protein milk until evenly hydrated and creamy (filmed sequence: water → flakes → milk). No butter or oil is added.
  • Divide the finished mash into 4 equal adult side portions (each equals 22g dry flakes and 1/4 cup Nurri milk) and pair each adult plate with 210g beef sauerbraten and gravy.

If something fails

Mashed potatoes feel too thick or stiff after standing: Stir in an extra splash of hot water or protein milk right before plating to loosen the potato flakes to your preferred creaminess.

Want to log exact macros from your own kitchen: Weigh 210g heated beef sauerbraten with gravy per adult plate and divide the 88g flake + 240ml milk mash batch into 4 equal portions; any extra butter, chili flakes, or kid rolls are separate.

Storage and reheating

Store: Store leftover heated beef sauerbraten with gravy and leftover mashed potatoes in separate airtight containers in the refrigerator for up to 3–4 days.

Reheat: Reheat beef and mash gently on the stovetop or in the microwave with a splash of water or milk to keep the mash creamy.

Lasts: Up to 3–4 days refrigerated.

Estimated nutrition

~360 cal | ~42g protein.

Adult plate label-based estimate is 362.5 calories, 41.5g protein, 24.25g total carbs, and 11g fat (displayed as ≈363 cal / 41.5g protein in captions and rounded to ≈360 cal / 42g protein in video). Component breakdown: 1 1/2 labeled servings (210g) À La Carte Beef Sauerbraten with gravy (240 cal, 34.5g protein, 6g carbs, 9g fat based on 140g label serving) + 1/4 of the 4-serving mash batch made from 88g Idahoan Original dry potato flakes (22g per serving: 80 cal, 2g protein, 17g carbs, 0g fat) and 1 cup / 240ml Nurri whole ultra-filtered milk (1/4 cup per serving: 42.5 cal, 5g protein, 1.25g carbs, 2g fat) + 1 1/2 cups water. No added butter or oil is included. Kids receive 105g beef (3/4 labeled serving) and mash to appetite; kids’ rolls and optional adult chili flakes are separate.
